name: Ripples (2020)
source: ripples_quickstart.pdf p2 (panel diagram, 2020 version); Mutable Instruments | Ripples.pdf p1-2
notes: FM and RESO CV jacks have no printed label (dotted lines to the FM attenuverter and RESO knob). IN 1 is soft-clipped, IN 2 clean; both mixed. LEVEL is a VCA CV for the LP output, normalled to +7V. Outputs are printed as HP/BP/LP filter-shape icons. VCV port list (5 in / 4 out incl. LP4 VCA) reflects the original Ripples, not the 2020 version, so counts differ by design.
